svg.desc: /research:run — execution architecture — fans, joins, gates and the iteration loop
svg.text: execution architecture — fans, joins, gates and the iteration loop
FAN = lanes dispatched in one turn
↺ dashed = same stage reused, see its home card · ×2 = runs twice
one path per invocation: default, --team or --resume

g.text: no change · out of scope → RECORD

svg.text: Escalation: proposals applied one at a time,
scope check → record like any iteration.

g.text: team_mode set → TEAM PATH ▴, stored phase

svg.text: exactly one path runs per invocation
● own stage · ↺ same stage reused, see its home card · ○ absent or skipped

g.text: one per flag · both set = parallel
lead applies each, best confidence first
nested, no Agent tool → ideation inline
oracle or analyst silent → ⏱, partial queue
Anchors: SETUP–BASELINE = SKILL.md R1–R4, pre-phase R0 after R2 · loop = R5 · REPORT–DELEGATION = R6–R7.
Diagram only — SKILL.md is normative; update both with any step/gate/fan-out change.
